 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 41.6 Gurnoor Brar to Kristian Clarke, 1 run, clipped towards square leg by Kristian Clarke for a single 41.5 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, 1 run, driven to cover where Ruturaj dives to his right and grabs it. Recovers well in time to fire a throw at the bowler's end, but wasn't accurate enough. Wasn't in complete control, hence it turned out to be a wayward throw 41.4 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, no run, tad short outside off, Mitchell Santner steers it into the off-side 41.3 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, no run, sticks to the shortish length, Mitchell Santner gets on top of it, knocks it on to the pitch 41.2 Gurnoor Brar to Kristian Clarke, 1 run, short one at the hips, Kristian Clarke tucks it towards fine leg for a single 41.2 Gurnoor Brar to Kristian Clarke, wide , short in length but fired down the leg-side by Gurnoor Brar 41.1 Gurnoor Brar to Kristian Clarke, no run, back of a length delivery outside off, tad slower and Kristian Clarke gets beaten on the outside edge 39.6 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, no run, short of length outside off, Mitchell Santner gets forward to drive on the rise, beaten on the outside edge 39.5 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, no run, yorker length on off, Mitchell Santner gets forward to dig it out to cover 39.4 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, no run, full on middle and off, Mitchell Santner gets forward to defend to cover 39.3 Gurnoor Brar to Kristian Clarke, 1 run, good length and nips back in a tad to off and middle, Kristian Clarke goes on the back foot and turns it to the mid-wicket area for one 39.2 Gurnoor Brar to Kristian Clarke, no run, dug in short at Kristian Clarke who ducks and it's called as one for the over 39.1 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, 1 run, length delivery outside off, Mitchell Santner gets forward to drive, the thick outside edge runs away to third man 37.6 Gurnoor Brar to Kristian Clarke, no run, back of a length outside off, holds its line, Kristian Clarke pokes and misses. Past the outside edge 37.5 W Gurnoor Brar to Michael Bracewell, out Caught by Naman Dhir!! What a fine catch that is running in from deep backward square-leg. Dhir the man. Cleanly into the two hands and then as he falls to ground, the left hand goes off as he lands softly with the ball in the right. It's a pacy short of length delivery on middle, rushes Michael Bracewell who goes on the back foot to pull, miscued and it seemed to be landing in space till Dhir sprinted forward and took it. The sunglasses were on and he judged it well. India with two quick wickets as they try to limit the total to chaseable proportions. Michael Bracewell c Naman Dhir b Gurnoor Brar 15(20) [4s-1] 37.4 Gurnoor Brar to Michael Bracewell, no run, fullish outside off, Michael Bracewell gets forward to defend in front of backward point and wants a quick single, Mitchell Santner isn't interested 37.3 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Mitchell Santner goes on the back foot and taps it to the left of backward point for an easy single 37.2 Gurnoor Brar to Mitchell Santner, no run, good length and tight on middle, Mitchell Santner gets forward and right behind the line to defend it back 37.1 Gurnoor Brar to Michael Bracewell, 1 run, short of length and nips back in a tad to off from round the wicket, Michael Bracewell goes on the back foot and nudges it towards square leg 29.6 Gurnoor Brar to Finn Allen, no run, good length outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and taps to backward point. A loud groan of "no" from him follows 29.5 4 Gurnoor Brar to Finn Allen, FOUR , the thick outside edge now flies away to third man who's very square. On a back of a length outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches, the thick outside edge flies away 29.4 4 Gurnoor Brar to Finn Allen, FOUR , beautiful straight drive. Full just outside off, Finn Allen gets forward to drive and even though it comes off the thick inner half of the bat, it races past the stumps at the other end. He is a strongly built man. Wide of mid-on 29.3 Gurnoor Brar to Finn Allen, no run, short outside off, left alone and Ishan Kishan leaps to collect 29.2 Gurnoor Brar to Finn Allen, no run, fullish outside off, Finn Allen gets forward to drive and mistimes it to cover. "Wait on" is the shout from Allen to Will Young 29.1 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, 1 run, full on middle, Will Young gets forward to flick to the right of mid-wicket for one 27.6 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short outside off, Will Young sinks low and sways away to leave. The height is just fine according to Kumar Dharmasena 27.5 4 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, FOUR , what timing from Will Young. It's a short of length delivery outside off, he goes on the back foot and punches with an open-face. Was in the air but well wide of Axar and square third man. A disappointed look from Gurnoor Brar as he knows he is giving too much width. Young is racing away to his 100 27.4 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short of length and tight on off, Will Young goes on the back foot and defends to his right. Wants a run as he looks at Finn Allen but they don't risk it as Gurnoor Brar chases 27.3 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, Axar dives to his right and saves runs at backward point. On a short of length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches that nicely with an open-face. If not for Axar that was probably four 27.2 6 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, SIX , "catch" was the cry but this is all the way over square third man. It's short of length delivery outside off, Will Young slashes and it flies off the bat. Into the crowd 27.1 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, good length and tight on off, Will Young gets forward and right behind the line to defend it back 17.6 4 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, FOUR , this time no chance for Rohit or deep square leg. Short outside off, predictable and Will Young is waiting for it, he goes on the back foot and smashes it wide of both mid-wicket and the deep fielder. Rockets away to the deep mid-wicket fence 17.5 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, Rohit at mid-wicket dives to his right and saves four. Short outside off, Will Young absolutely smashed the pull and Rohit sticks out an outstretched right hand and half-stops. That's good enough. Gurnoor Brar claps and appreciates that effort 17.4 Gurnoor Brar to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, short of length and around off, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and defends with soft hands into the vacant silly-point area 17.3 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, 1 run, full on off, angled in, Will Young gets forward to flick to the right of deep square leg 17.2 Gurnoor Brar to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, short of length on middle, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and taps it in front of mid-on. Easy single in the end to Nabi 17.1 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, 1 run, yorker length outside off, Will Young jams down on it and squeezes it down to third man 15.6 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short outside off, rising, Will Young slashes and misses. Flies over the top-edge 15.5 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, full outside off, Will Young gets forward and across to drive to cover 15.4 4 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, FOUR , lucky four for Will Young. It's a short of length delivery and nips back in to off, Young defends close to the body, the thick inside edge flies over the stumps and goes well wide even as Ishan Kishan dives to his left to try and cut it off 15.3 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short of length and zippy outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and is rushed on the pull, misses. Clearly beaten for pace there 15.2 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, beaten! On a short of length and angle in and then holds its line to beat the tentative prod of Will Young. It bounced too 15.1 Gurnoor Brar to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, full outside off, Dean Foxcroft gets forward to drive to sweeper cover 13.6 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, length delivery down leg, Will Young flicks and misses. Off the pad to the mid-wicket area 13.5 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short and outside off, rising even as Will Young goes on the back foot to pull. Misses and Ishan Kishan leaps to collect 13.4 6 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, SIX , all the way over fine-leg's head. It's short and clearly rushes Will Young for pace, he takes it on from around off, goes on the back foot and the top-edge helps. Sails over the fielder's head who's Kuldeep 13.3 Gurnoor Brar to Nick Kelly, 1 run, full on off, Nick Kelly gets forward to drive to mid-off's left. Takes on Nabi and gets in easily. Puts in the dive to ensure he is safe even as the throw misses easily 13.2 Gurnoor Brar to Nick Kelly, no run, that's a good delivery. Short of a length and maybe pitched outside leg, seams away and opens Nick Kelly up, hit on the back arm - the left one. No arm-guard and that would've hurt 13.1 Gurnoor Brar to Nick Kelly, 2 runs, full and down leg, Nick Kelly gets forward and flicks through vacant mid-wicket. Mid-on cuts it off 11.6 W Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, out Caught by Ishan Kishan!! Gurnoor Brar sends Tim Seifert off. Words between them. It's short outside off, Seifert is rushed on the pull. The weight is on the front foot. High on the bat and it seems to be landing between Ishan Kishan and fine-leg but the keeper with the big gloves on runs to his left and dives forward to take it two-handed. That's a good catch as he judged it well. As soon as the catch was taken, Brar got in Seifert's face roaring in celebration. Needed Virat Kohli of all people to pull Brar away from Seifert. Even as Kohli was pushing Brar away, he roars a come on at Seifert. Surely pantomime villain stuff. Tim Seifert c Ishan Kishan b Gurnoor Brar 58(48) [4s-6 6s-3] 11.5 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, full and coming back into off, Tim Seifert gets forward to flick, the thick inside edge hits the leg and rolls to mid-wicket 11.4 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man where Rohit is there 11.3 4 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, FOUR , what a fine shot that is. Short and rising outside off, Will Young rises tall and uses the pace and bounce to direct it wide of backward point. No chance for third man who's very square. Played it down too 11.2 Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and swivels to pull, but finds mid-wicket 11.1 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, 1 run, short of length on middle, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and closes the face of the bat to nudge to deep backward square-leg and Nabi is quick, he keeps it to one 6.6 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, short of length outside off, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and punches nicely to point, straight to the fielder 6.5 4 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, FOUR , Gurnoor Brar has been smashed for four but he is having words with Tim Seifert. It's short of length outside off, Seifert picks the length so well, goes on the back foot and smashes the pull, well wide of mid-wicket. No-one in the deep and Brar went after Seifert with words 6.4 4 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, FOUR , beautiful back foot punch. On a back of a length outside off, even though he was cramped, Tim Seifert is on his tiptoes as he punches wide of backward point, no chance for Kuldeep running to his right at square third man 6.3 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, short of length outside off, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and defends solidly to cover. "No run" Seifert screams 6.2 6 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, SIX , that's a T20 shot. Full and in the slot on middle, Tim Seifert gets forward and clears his front leg to loft. Flies all the way over long-on. Dropped in the crowd. Went off the middle of the bat 6.1 Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, fullish and angled in on middle, Tim Seifert gets forward and flicks, was in the air for a while but lands miles short of mid-wicket LATEST NEWS
